caption: Accuracy and macro F1 of five classifiers under image-, specimen- and article-level cross-validation (mean and SD over five folds) and pooled leave-one-article-out. The dashed line is the majority-class accuracy. The dotted line is the source prior under specimen-level folds: each test image gets the majority label of its source in the training part.
strings:
By specimen every classifier trails a source prior that sees no crack; by article none clearly
beats the majority.
